name: Haus Maringele
beschreibung: The Haus Maringele is peacefully situated in a sunny setting on the edge of Nesselwängle in Tyrol's scenic Tannheimer Tal. The inviting guest rooms are decorated with native timber and feature modern private bathrooms, free Wi-Fi, and balconies framing dramatic views of the towering Rotflüh and Gimpel massifs. A generous morning breakfast buffet loaded with local delicacies fuels outdoor enthusiasts for their alpine adventures. In summer, the guesthouse serves as an ideal base for high-altitude hikes, via ferratas, and strolls around nearby Lake Haldensee. In winter, cross-country skiers can join groomed valley tracks within steps, while local ski lifts cater to alpine fans.
kurzbeschreibung: Family-run guesthouse in Nesselwängle in the Tannheimer Tal offering panoramic views of Mount Rotflüh and warm hospitality.
